legacy_dependency_findings.finding: buildShareCard, buildCipherCanvas and buildCipherGrid draw by st.theme (royal/klaf/classic) with Georgia/Arial, the engine slot colours and a text-only brand. The native 2029 save asks the engine for them (native-save -> image + shape).
Three engine themes (royal, klaf, classic) with theme buttons and body classes; the register marks them SUPERSEDED (A07-A09) yet they still choose the card palette and the Classic UI look.

315 hex literals (115 distinct) in the engine template; 12 legacy slot colours are stored inside saved findings. The 2029 matrix projects them to the approved palette.matrix (projectFindingColor); the canvases do not.

Engine CSS uses Frank Ruhl Libre / David Libre / Georgia and system-ui; canvases use Georgia and Arial. The 2029 matrix uses TYPEFACE.display (Rubik). 'classic glyphs' remains an intentional 2029 option.
The engine embeds the old ELS logo as a data URI and a text signature; no card uses the Brand Core lockup (brandAssets2029.js, approved full lockup, no crop or redraw).

Cards are uploaded to the public gallery bucket under random names (442 objects, 126 MB, at most 130 referenced); private saves upload nothing; 120 of 143 rows cannot be re-rendered exactly (no stored start_index).
Share link is native (ElsMatrixShare2029, URL only). The PNG download and the share text with the emoji are Classic-only.
The engine's own popups, selection bar, toasts, one browser dialog call and .vb buttons exist only inside the Classic UI; the native surface uses the shared Royal components.
The engine UI is mounted as els29-classic-fallback (hidden unless classicOpen) and reachable from the public cipher page, the library card and the matrix-reading activity.

elsMatrixZoom.js mirrors the classic engine geometry (duplicate presentation math); spatial fixtures import public/tzofen.html and the tk data; /tzofen.html has redirects and routes; 37 test/script files reference the template or its output; the old els-logo.png is used on the Home page.
The canonical engine (search, verification, ranking, geometry, the replay gate) is not Legacy UI and is kept; no function in this register is to be replaced or duplicated.

legacy_removal_plan.principle: one computational engine, one 2029 drawing mechanism, one design language, one Brand Core; zero Legacy UI without losing a research capability (ZURIEL 26.11.2026). Work is tracked through this register: every row below names its slice.

slices.title: Finish #1565
slices.scope: grant hardening SQL, merge, deployment, canary, one real save
slices.gate: separate exact approval per step: SQL, merge, deploy, alias

slices.title: Parity trace of the 13 Classic-only rows
slices.scope: prove for each row the native code path and a fixture/browser test, or record the gap; update owners and class; no code change
slices.gate: register test; ZURIEL reviews the gap list

slices.title: Native surfaces for the true gaps
slices.scope: expose existing engine output through shared Royal components; no new computation, lazy-loaded (Speed Law)
slices.gate: fixture + browser test per row; speed gates unchanged

slices.title: One 2029 card renderer
slices.scope: pure model-to-image module fed by the native projection (state.matrix), palette.matrix + projectFindingColor, TYPEFACE, the Brand Core lockup and elsMatrixZoom geometry; minimum cell 26 px (the app default); a long axis gets a taller card, never smaller letters; tested on 3 long-axis samples against real crawler previews before the OG variant is fixed
slices.gate: sample approval by ZURIEL; render determinism test; no Legacy import

slices.title: Automatic image on save and update
slices.scope: save and update ask the 2029 renderer (not the engine canvas); deterministic public path v2/<id>.png; private rows get a private bucket image, never image_url
slices.gate: SQL proposal (private bucket, policies, CHECK) needs its own approval; isolated Postgres tests

slices.title: Backfill of existing ciphers
slices.scope: worker on the existing media-thumbs pattern; exact rows re-rendered from stored locators, legacy rows only when a single occurrence matches, the rest to a review list; image_url backup first; private ones rendered by their owner on next open
slices.gate: dry run first; approval to run; old objects kept 30 days; orphan cleanup is separate

slices.title: Retire the Legacy engine UI
slices.scope: (a) close Classic entry points, (b) remove the els29-classic-fallback mount, (c) cut UI code from tools/els while the computation stays, (d) remove themes, canvas builders, els-logo assets and the mirrored geometry, (e) migrate the 37 referencing tests
slices.gate: S1/S2 parity complete, S5 done, each deletion approved by ZURIEL; history in Git is the recovery path

slices.title: Home section marker
slices.scope: replace the old /els-logo.png image with the existing NavigationIcon2029 "els" (Brand Core governs the lockup, not section icons); one image request fewer

slices.title: One geometry source
slices.scope: elsMatrixZoom.js is the single presentation geometry (native, folded matrix and the card renderer); the engine copies (buildMatrix, fitMatrixToScreen, markedBBox) and the card builders constants disappear with S6; parity test until then
slices.gate: existing zoom tests + a card/native parity test
